xai_methods.name: Grad-CAM
xai_methods.description: Highlights image regions that influence the selected classification output using gradients flowing into the final convolutional feature maps.

xai_methods.name: Grad-CAM++
xai_methods.description: A gradient-based class activation mapping method that utilizes weighted positive higher-order partial derivatives to provide finer spatial explanations.

xai_methods.name: Integrated Gradients
xai_methods.description: Attributes a model output to input pixels by accumulating gradients along a linear path between a neutral baseline image and the input scan.

xai_methods.name: Mask-Targeted Grad-CAM
xai_methods.description: Computes backpropagated gradients targeting the summed logit activations of the predicted lesion mask to reveal which latent feature channels drove boundary delineation.

xai_methods.name: Mask-Guided CAM
xai_methods.description: Isolates activation maps spatially conditioned on the segmented Tumor Core ROI, explaining internal heterogeneity within the lesion.

xai_methods.name: Segmentation Integrated Gradients
xai_methods.description: Calculates path-integral pixel attributions directly conditioned on the segmentation mask loss against a blank reference baseline.
